comparison.objective: Draw one syringe dose in a single pull without reversal or overdraw; candidate tunes impact damping iteratively.
comparison.physical_skill: Needle/vial alignment and precise one-way plunger control versus hex-key/collar manipulation and repeated guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Correct dose with no push-back or overdraw versus two non-bottoming stops with no excessive rebound or drift.
comparison.reason: Both demand fine control, but their mechanisms, irreversible constraints and measured outcomes are different. Numeric dose thresholds are absent.
